page.notes: The Greek words in the first paragraph and in the thesis "I." are doubtful: "ἐεἰδ[?]" and "ἢ νοῦ" are not fully legible at this scan resolution. The ornamental border line between the opening paragraph and the chapter heading is decoration and was omitted. The marginal note "Methodus / est duplex." is printed in two lines in the margin and is transcribed as one note. The "V 2" signature is at the foot of the page.
